selection: seed 25017 selects 10 of 16 >=2500-character documents in independent offsets 25000..25047; one manually selected target per document
caveat: Target selection within documents is purposive, not a task prevalence sample; one reader and several copy/topic shortcuts. Evidence is paraphrased.

sites.evidence: Current biography introduced Mark Worthington; other biographies name different attorneys.
sites.shortcut: Same first name appears earlier in the current biography teaser.

sites.evidence: The borough and local community recur throughout the interview.
sites.shortcut: Many recent repeats make this an easy topic-copy site.

sites.evidence: The article distinguishes several prospects, including Bryant and Rogers, by their situations.
sites.shortcut: The continuation can use topical association, not necessarily a structured entity graph.

sites.evidence: An earlier player is the personalized-greeting example; a later sentence names a donating player.
sites.shortcut: The donation fact is introduced at this point, so exact donor choice is not compelled.

sites.evidence: The article focuses on Ingram before a long table of opponents and rankings.
sites.shortcut: Topic prominence alone may explain the speaker name.

sites.evidence: The page earlier distinguishes a former leader from the current leader of the blue dragonflight.
sites.shortcut: The target begins a newly supplied lore claim; prior role does not determine wording.

sites.evidence: The article names both formations; recent mineralization discussion concerns the Rosebel deposit.
sites.shortcut: A nearby Rosebel mention suffices; long context is unnecessary.

sites.evidence: An interview presents numbered questions 1 and 2 before the target question.
sites.shortcut: Heading sequence predicts the number, not the question content.

sites.evidence: The contracting company was introduced in the page header and prior service sections.
sites.shortcut: The company name has been repeated, including nearby.

sites.evidence: The lecture header names the speaker; a later section starts his biography.
sites.shortcut: The name is present in the header and nearby section transition.
